_comment: snapshot-derived metrics copied from GET /api/careers/2134; 'missing' and 'zero' are hand-made edge cases

pay_median.note: Median gross annual pay of full-time adult employees who have been in the job for over a year, tax year 2024/25. It is not starting pay. Range: 25th to 75th percentile (the middle half).

demand_trend.note: Yearly change in full-time employee jobs compared with the typical occupation, 2022 to 2025 (+0.02 = growing 2% a year faster). Robust (Theil-Sen) trend; range is a 90% interval including ONS sampling error.

exposure.note: Generative-AI exposure of the job's tasks (ILO 2025), averaged over the international codes its UK job titles map to. Range: how much exposure varies across its tasks and codes, widened where the UK (DfE) estimate disagrees.

zero.note: Yearly change in full-time employee jobs compared with the typical occupation, 2022 to 2025 (+0.02 = growing 2% a year faster). Robust (Theil-Sen) trend; range is a 90% interval including ONS sampling error.
